summary: Brightstar Lottery PLC (NYSE: BRSL) filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, reporting its first-quarter 2026 results as of March 31, 2026. The filing includes financial highlights: revenue of $587M, income from continuing operations of $63M, and Adjusted EBITDA of $287M. The company also announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.23 per share, payable June 11, 2026, to holders of record on May 28, 2026. This is a routine earnings release and dividend declaration, not a special-situation event. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic transaction is disclosed. The filing is a standard periodic report under the 1934 Act.
